fields.name: playback_correlation_id
fields.doc: ID generated by the OpenConnect Control Plane (OCP) for each manifest it generates.

fields.name: cdn_id
fields.doc: Uniquely identified each OpenConnect Appliance

fields.name: oca_uuid
fields.doc: UUID that uniquely identifies each OpenConnect Appliance

fields.name: oca_firmware_id
fields.doc: OCA firmware at the time the row was generated, updated once per quarter. </br> Example: release-2023Q3.1.3-oca-r202307181352

fields.name: site_org_name
fields.doc: Name of the deployment site, and the organization that operates that site.  Joined with ".". </br> Examples: den002.centurylink, atl004.ix

fields.name: route_cluster_name
fields.doc: Name of the a cluster route </br> Examples: ix.atl004.b, ix.ewr002.b

fields.name: manifest_cluster_name
fields.doc: Name of the cluster in manifests </br> Examples: ix.atl004.b.hca, virginmedia.isp-lgw002-3

fields.name: device_type_id
fields.doc: Device type identifier

fields.name: playback_country_iso_code
fields.doc: Country used by the Play API to determine title availability

fields.name: geo_country_iso_code
fields.doc: Country returned by client IP/Geo lookup during the manifest fetch

fields.name: oca_country_iso_code
fields.doc: Country the OCA is deployed in

fields.name: ocp_reported_client_asn
fields.doc: ASN returned by client IP/ASN lookup during the manifest fetch

fields.name: title_id
fields.doc: Title identifier

fields.name: title_runtime_secs
fields.doc: Title runtime in seconds

fields.name: package_id
fields.doc: Title identifier

fields.name: account_id
fields.doc: Account identifier

fields.name: profile_id
fields.doc: Profile identifier

fields.name: ocp_transport_desc
fields.doc: Transit type description </br> Examples: Transit, Peered, Embedded

fields.name: ocp_detailed_transport_desc
fields.doc: Detailed transit type description </br> Examples: Transit, IX Peered, Embedded, PNI Peered, Paid Peered, Routerless IXP

fields.name: ocp_route
fields.doc: OCP Route

fields.name: ocp_aspath_asns
fields.doc: List of ASNs on the path between client and OCA

fields.name: ocp_reported_client_ip
fields.doc: Client IP address, as reported by OCP

fields.name: ocp_proximity_ranked_manifest_clusters
fields.doc: Information about stacks, grouped and ordered by proximity_rank

fields.name: ocp_steered_downloadables
fields.doc: Information about each downloadable available when the manifest was generated

fields.name: ocp_selection_ranked
fields.doc: Bytes sent, grouped by type (total, video, audio, text) and rank (ALL, primary, secondary, tertiary_plus)

fields.name: ocp_cdn_rank
fields.doc: The rank of this OCA in the manifest as calculated by OCP.  Higher rank indicates the client chose not to use lower rank OCAs

fields.name: ocp_ranked_cdns
fields.doc: The list of cdn_ids, ordered by rank as calculated by OCP

fields.name: ocp_final_ranked_stacks
fields.doc: The list of stacks, ordered by rank as calculated by OCP

fields.name: ocp_level
fields.doc: CDN Level as calculated by OCP. </br> Looked up in cdn_selections.other_properties.cdn_levels

fields.name: ocp_pr0_stats
fields.doc: Bytes sent, grouped by shed classification (streamed_bytes, health_shed_bytes, content_shed_bytes, other_shed_bytes)

fields.name: oca_sent_bytes
fields.doc: Bytes sent, as reported by the OCA

fields.name: oca_sent_downloadables
fields.doc: Information about each downloadable sent to a client, as reported by the OCA

fields.name: oca_tcp_stats
fields.doc:
Deprecated - Use `oca_tcp_stats_v2_list`
Summary stats for TCP connections in this oca session

fields.name: oca_tcp_stats_v2_list
fields.doc:
List of stats for each TCP connection in this oca session
*Introduced: 20230901*
See: [Netflix T-Digest Documentation](https://manuals.netflix.net/view/sde.nflx_tdigest/mkdocs/master/tdigest/)

  • connection_id - Unique identifier for this connection. Currently sourced from cdn_selections.other_properties.rowId

  • template_schema_hash - Version identifier for the TCP stats json blob

  • payload_bytes - Payload bytes

  • retransmit_bytes - Retransmit bytes

  • mss_bytes - Maximum segment size in bytes

  • stack_bytes_served - List of stack names and their associated bytes served

  • rtt_tdigest - Netflix T-Digest

  • gput_tdigest - Netflix T-Digest

  • path_rtt_tdigest - Netflix T-Digest

  • unique_connection_count - Should always be 1 in this table

  • total_connection_count - Should always be 1 in this table

fields.name: oca_uri_request_cnt
fields.doc: Number of HTTP requests served by connections in this oca session

fields.name: oca_playback_session_dom_firmware_id
fields.doc: Deprecated - Use `oca_tcp_stats_v2_list` If a firmware has served 95% or more of the bytes for this oca session, it will be listed here

fields.name: oca_playback_session_dom_stack
fields.doc: Deprecated - Use `oca_tcp_stats_v2_list.stack_bytes_served` If a stack has served 95% or more of the bytes for this oca session, it will be listed here

fields.name: oca_tcp_conn_cnt
fields.doc: Number of TCP connections, as reported by the OCA

fields.name: oca_tcp_conn_keys
fields.doc:
Deprecated - Use `oca_tcp_stats_v2_list.connection_id`
row_id for all connections present

fields.name: oca_tcp_conn_duration_ms
fields.doc: Sum of TCP connection durations, as reported by the OCA, in milliseconds

fields.name: is_oca_conn_params_changed
fields.doc: Flag indicating if this connection parameters changed during this oca session.  1 = true, 0 = false

fields.name: oca_conn_params_changed_type
fields.doc: Description of the connection parameter change type </br> Examples: UNSET, LATESET, SET

fields.name: oca_first_tcp_conn_start_utc_epoch_ts
fields.doc: Epoch millisecond timestamp for start of first connection

fields.name: oca_last_tcp_conn_end_utc_epoch_ts
fields.doc: Epoch millisecond timestamp for end of last connection

fields.name: oca_pbcid_first_tcp_conn_start_utc_epoch_ts
fields.doc: Epoch millisecond timestamp for start of first connection for a given playback_correlation_id

fields.name: oca_reported_client_asn
fields.doc: Client ASN based on IP lookup by OCA

fields.name: oca_reported_client_ip
fields.doc: Client IP address, as reported by the OCA

fields.name: is_https_session
fields.doc: Flag indicating if this oca session was served via HTTPS.  1 = true, 0 = false

fields.name: is_ipv6_session
fields.doc: Flag indicating if the first IP address seen by the OCA in this oca session was IPV6.  1 = true, 0 = false

fields.name: oca_ssl_cipher
fields.doc: Name of the SSL cipher used by the OCA

fields.name: oca_sab_test_id
fields.doc: If this oca session was included in an AB test, the test id will be listed here

fields.name: oca_sab_cell_num
fields.doc: If this oca session was included in an AB test, the test cell number will be listed here

fields.name: debug
fields.doc: Debug fields

fields.name: is_download
fields.doc: Flag indicating if this oca session was for downloading.  1 = true, 0 = false

fields.name: playback_context_flavor
fields.doc: Playback flavor </br> Examples: LEGACY, PRE_FETCH, STANDARD, DOWNLOAD, QC

fields.name: is_supplemental_playback
fields.doc: Flag indicating if this oca session was part of a live playback session.  1 = true, 0 = false

fields.name: supplemental_subtype
fields.doc: Supplemental subtype </br> Examples: UNKNOWN_SUPPLEMENTAL_SUB_TYPE, AD, IDENT

fields.name: utc_date
fields.doc: UTC date int </br> Examples: 20230801

fields.name: utc_hour
fields.doc: UTC hour
